column1: # Previous mean of top-level PASS records from three successful post-#998
# main-push Go CI runs, successively refreshed with passing native-shard samples
# cache disabled, warm Go dependency cache). The first three runs had all four
# native jobs pass but were cancelled or failed before overall validation
# passed; shards 0 and 1 failed after runner shutdown, and overall validation
# failed. Run 43772111703 also failed Windows; run 43776438029 failed after
# coverage receipts verified. These refreshes are for placement only, not
# all native shards after serializing the frozen-reader oracle cases. The prior
# assignment measured job durations of 1252/1204/1398/1111 seconds (max/min 1.258).
# Refreshing the split parity-test costs predicts 1123.79/1125.08/1124.02/1124.48
# seconds of test work before runner overhead; this PR run is not acceptance evidence.
# Run 43965139798 attempt 1 (060cbe61) passed the full PR workflow after the
# Windows-shutdown fix and latest-main merge. Replace every observed top-level
# PASS duration below with its uncached race/atomic result. Native job durations
# were 1157/1077/976/1342 seconds (max/min 1.375); this PR run is not acceptance
# on Linux, so their previous zero estimates remain unchanged.
# Tests with a completed PASS in the latest run use that top-level duration;
# rows without a passing sample retain their prior estimate. Use disjoint child
# PASS durations only when cases moved between top-level tests; never add child
# durations to their parent when calculating a cost.
